llm_response.reason: Shoppok.com is an online classifieds aggregation site, similar to Craigslist, where users can post and browse listings. The domain has existed since 2007 under a reputable registrar, with Reddit discussions confirming its role as a general-purpose platform. While there are reports of scam listings, these stem from individual users rather than the platform itself. Unlike scam websites, shoppok.com does not promise guaranteed returns, require verification fees, impersonate brands, or display the other primary characteristics of fraudulent websites. Caution should be used with specific listings as with any classifieds platform.
